about_the_game:
Bring the jungle heat to the city streets with the Tacky Toucan Pack, a fashion crime in three parts, and you're guilty on all counts.

Whether you're blending in with tropical birds or standing out in the grey streets of New Yolk, this set is loud, proud, and completely ridiculous.

With this pack you'll get access to:

  • Toucan Skin: A vibrant beak and feathers soaked in sass. Say less, squawk more.

  • Blonde Wig: Flowing golden locks that scream “natural”, if you squint hard enough.

  • Polka Dot Glasses: Red, round, and ridiculous. The perfect match for someone who sees fashion as a challenge.
